scope: ordinary cached source text only; no imports or native execution

findings.entry: dist/index.cjs imports constructor and native loader, so merely importing sharp is not inert
findings.defaults: input.cjs default pixel cap 0x3fff squared and animated false do not establish our full bounded single-image contract
findings.metadata: input.cjs explicitly describes metadata as header-only, not full decode
findings.timeout: output.cjs timer starts when vips opens image; excludes libuv queue wait
findings.limits: common.cc enforces width times height and channel caps but these are not OS memory/CPU isolation or a complete worker deadline
